name: Roasted Sockeye Salmon "Salade Niçoise" with Green Bean, Avocado & Egg
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and discard ends of the green beans; transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat; spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until green beans are fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly.
While the green beans are roasting, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on another baking sheet. Drizzle with oil and season with spices.
Add baking sheet to the oven and roast until salmon is opaque and flakes easily with a fork, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, halve tomatoes and place on a large plate.
Peel and thinly slice shallots into rings; add to the plate with the tomatoes.
Halve eggs lengthwise; add to the plate.
Halve and pit avocado. Slice thinly while still in the skin, then scoop out onto the plate.
Separate lettuce into leaves and divide between plates. Top with green beans, salmon, tomatoes, shallots, eggs, avocado, olives, and capers. Serve with vinaigrette on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
